newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Air Products said cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Air Products said cut.

text.p: -- Air Products and Chemicals Inc was cut to an unattractive from a neutral on Monday, according to a source at PaineWebber.
-- Analyst Paul Raman confirmed the cut and said the company's valuation suggests shares should be worth about $55 each, giving the stock a nearly 30 percent downside.

-- In a research report, Raman said he expected the company to earn $3.70 for fiscal 1997, with $0.91 in the first quarter, $0.91 in the second quarter, $0.93 in the third quarter and $0.95 in the fourth quarter.

-- "We believe the stock should trade at 16 times earnings. With our estimate of $3.70 in F1997, this implies a target price of $60. Second, the company may have $6.90 in gross cash flowin F1997. If we value this cash flow at 7.5 times, this implies a target price of $50," he said in a research report.
